verified_facts.text: Rosewood Sanya is billed as the Beacon of Haitang Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt:
# Rosewood Sanya

The Beacon of Haitang Bay

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have an intimate residential feel and look out over the South China Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms and suites with an intimate residential feel that celebrate the sprawling views of the South China Sea

verified_facts.text: Haitang House is an oceanfront accommodation with sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breathtaking sea views meet understated elegance in Haitang House, a serene oceanfront haven for an unforgettable escape.

verified_facts.text: Riyue Residence is a private accommodation with ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private sanctuary, where ocean views inspire connection and quiet moments of exquisite indulgence unfold.

verified_facts.text: The Fishmonger is a market-style seafood restaurant with open kitchens serving the day's freshest catch.
verified_facts.excerpt: The day’s freshest catch can be enjoyed in this market-style restaurant with open kitchens that visually excite the appetite.

verified_facts.text: The Fishmonger offers a Hainan hotpot with Puqian Zuopo Vinegar Broth.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complete your local flavor journey with a taste of Puqian Zuopo Vinegar Broth

verified_facts.text: Chop House is a seaside Italian grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seaside dining at its most elegant, serving the freshest produce grilled to perfection

verified_facts.text: East Kitchen is an Asian bistro serving comfort food inspired by Southeast Asian signature dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sophisticated modern lounge offering simple yet impeccably executed comfort foods inspired by Southeast Asian signature dishes.

verified_facts.text: The Lounge serves light bites, specialty cocktails, rare wines and craft beers.
verified_facts.excerpt: A relaxing spot to enjoy light bites and a stellar lineup of specialty cocktails, rare wines and painstakingly sourced craft beers.

verified_facts.text: HAI-Infinity Pool & Bar is a poolside bar with panoramic ocean views and drinks crafted by a resident mixologist.
verified_facts.excerpt: This vertiginous hotel bar with panoramic ocean views offer classic standards and signature drinks crafted by a resident mixologist.

verified_facts.text: The infinity pool is on the 13th floor.
The resort has a Family Pool and a Garden Pool on the 1st floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: the 1st-floor Family Pool from October 8 to October 25. During this period, the north side of the 13th-floor Infinity Pool and the 1st-floor Garden Pool will remain open

verified_facts.text: The spa is Senses, A Rosewood Spa, offering personalized treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Senses, A Rosewood Spa

Enter a space of respite from the rush of daily life and allow yourself to restore tranquility through personalized treatments.

verified_facts.text: A Hainan Fire Dance, rooted in harvest celebrations of Hainan's ethnic minorities, is staged at the Garden Pool.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Garden Pool

Originating from the harvest celebrations of Hainan's ethnic minorities and their reverence for fire

verified_facts.text: The hotel can arrange sailing along Sanya's coastline aboard a super yacht.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take in the beauty of Sanya by sailing along its picturesque coastlines aboard a luxury super yacht.

verified_facts.text: Nanshan Temple, a Buddhist temple modeled on Tang Dynasty style, sits on a mountain overlooking the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: This large-scale Buddhist temple, modeled after the grand style of the Tang Dynasty, sits atop a mountain overlooking the sea.

verified_facts.text: Golf is offered as an experience on Sanya's courses.
verified_facts.excerpt: The beauty of Sanya's bucolic courses are set to distract even the most avid golfer
